preconditions: Native settings must remain alive and external22-field JSON backup verified before any mutation.
Preserve original current settings reference and hideFlags; never assign/destroy/clone InputSystem.settings.
Narrow scope initially rejects persistent settings assets; no asset dirty/save.
temporaryScope: Back up full JsonUtility payload externally and two changed public fields before changing either.
Keep public managed/native reference identical; restore scalar fields and exact JSON on every normal/failure/cancel exit.
Create/retire only the owned virtual Keyboard; retain and restore previous current keyboard, map state and temporary speeds/time.
inputVerification: QueueStateEvent only; do not call parameterless InputSystem.Update from an Editor callback. Explicit update-type overload is internal, not invoked.

First inspect3 normal runtime frames: requested keys, virtual device enabled/key state/current status, actual GameInputBindings value/action-device binding, PlayerMovement speed, Animator state and render serial.
If request/actual input differ, capture the cause metadata and exit/restore; do not fake movement, enlarge timeout or proceed to24 eye readbacks.
laterMotionScope: Only after input connection/restore pass, same normal history stream may continue to phase6/walk8/turn10 segments with source/occlusion/final-cell correspondence; no new Play executed by this plan.
